tagline: Web tables to CSV, Excel and more

slides.title: Every table on the page, one click away
slides.text: Alt+T lists them with a preview. Copy as CSV, TSV, Markdown or JSON.

slides.title: Ready for Excel, in your language
slides.text: TSV pastes as cells. CSV with commas or semicolons. Numbers stay numbers in .xlsx (Pro).

slides.title: Only the columns you need
slides.text: Pick them, put them in your order, then copy or download. The preview follows.

slides.title: Merge tables from several pages
slides.text: Collect tables in a basket, export them as one table or one sheet per table.

slides.title: Private by design
slides.text: No account, no server, no network requests. A page is read only when you ask. Light and dark.
